title: Trump Administration Eases US Fuel Efficiency Standards
detail: The Trump administration eased US fuel efficiency rules. Trump claimed vehicle prices would fall as a result, though automotive and economic experts dispute the assessment.

title: US Military Tasked with Safeguarding Midterms After Trump Dismantled Election Security Agency
detail: The US military has been tasked with safeguarding the midterm elections after Trump dismantled the agency previously responsible for election protection, raising concerns among election security experts.

media.caption: US military tasked with election security role after Trump dismantled CISA
